title: 第5章 学到剑法了第6章 委屈何处说

;;
早课结束，苏白尘又在王行远的保护下跟着人流去饭堂吃早饭。
一碗大大的小米粥，还有两个大馒头，一叠酱菜……
这是苏白尘的早饭。
对此他也是早有心理准备，毕竟都进了长春宫修行，餐饮方面肯定是以清淡素净为主的。
而在这饭堂，苏白尘也是总算知道这一批的年轻弟子有多少个了……怕是有将近两百人！
这弟子人数也太多了吧？
苏白尘咋舌。
“王哥哥，苏小弟，终于找到你们了！”
苏白尘连忙循声看去，就见林招娣惊喜地抱着自己的粥碗菜碟走了过来。
“林姐姐，你也进来了，太好了，我们三人都入门了。”
他是挺高兴的。
或许是因为枫林子这边一共就他们三个，以至于三个小老乡在路途中就培养起了不错的感情。
“林姐姐，我今天早课的时候好像没看到你啊？”
林招娣带着腼腆的笑意答道：“我在女弟子那边上课……对了，听说今天上午我们会在一起学习一门剑法，我们已经错过了一天的教学，也不知道还能不能跟上进度。”
王行远惜字如金：“不怕。”
他很有自信。
苏白尘也应道：“我们认真学习肯定能够赶上进度。”
他觉得练剑什么的应该也是长春宫的前辈们为了给门下弟子强身健体用的，练得好坏应该没啥关系才对。
林招娣见两个同伴都很有信心，也就没说什么了。

“不过除了上午的练剑，下午听说还要识字上课，然后晚上才是学习炼气之法……听起来都很难。”
她依然是一脸的苦恼相。
苏白尘意外：“姐姐是怎么知道这么多的？”
王行远同样意外：“你怎么这些都不知道？”
苏白尘说不出话了。昨天是那个长谷道长送他过来的，一路上废话一大堆唯独没有说他接下来要面对的是什么。
王行远叹息一下：“行吧，我简单跟你说一下。”
“前三月，是所有新晋外门弟子的学习阶段。学习《长春经》，学习基础剑法，学习炼气术以及读书识字。”
“等到三月之后，如果有人能够直接完成引气入体，就能被收入门中成为正式弟子，并拜师学习更多东西。”
“若不行，则要领取诸多杂务，一边自己尝试修行，一边为长春宫完成一些力所能及的事务。”
“所以三月后如果能够成为正式弟子，那么就能继续专心修炼。否则就得要在外门中蹉跎了。”
苏白尘不停点头，他觉得这样的规矩很合理。
他此前还奇怪呢，这长春宫是靠什么养活这么多外门弟子的？现在得到解答了。
饭后休息了一刻钟，众人就去校场集合，该学剑了。
传剑的是个儒雅的青衫先生，叫做青锋寒，是专门教导外门的一个内门剑修。
他上来就让众人跟着他一起演练了三遍剑招，然后就让众人自由练习，他则是兴致来了指点一下，看起来颇为倦怠。
这种随意的教学也让苏白尘茫然了好一会儿。总算是依靠记忆力三遍将对方的路数全都记了下来，然后自己和小伙伴们一遍遍试验，一个上午也只是勉强做到像那么回事儿。
期间青锋寒只是对这边的三人小组看了两眼，并未有太多关注。

After the morning class, Su Baichen followed the crowd to the canteen for breakfast under the protection of Wang Xingyuan.
A big bowl of millet porridge, two big steamed buns, a stack of pickles...
This is Su Baichen's breakfast.
He had been mentally prepared for this. After all, he had entered the Changchun Palace to practice, so the food and beverages must be light and simple.
And in this dining hall, Su Baichen finally knew how many young disciples there were in this group... I'm afraid there were nearly two hundred people!
Are there too many disciples?
Su Baichen was speechless.
"Brother Wang, Little Brother Su, I finally found you!"
Su Baichen quickly followed the sound and saw Lin Zhaodi walking over with her porridge bowl and dishes in her hands in surprise.
"Sister Lin, you've come in too. That's great. All three of us have entered."
He was quite happy.
Perhaps it was because there were only three of them in Fenglinzi, so the three fellows developed a good relationship on the road.
"Sister Lin, I didn't seem to see you during morning class today?"
Lin Zhaodi replied with a shy smile: "I'm in class with the female disciples... By the way, I heard that we will learn a sword technique together this morning. We have missed a day of teaching, and we don't know if we can keep up with the progress."
Wang Xingyuan cherished his words like gold: "Don't be afraid."
He is very confident.
Su Baichen also responded: "We will definitely be able to catch up if we study hard."
He felt that sword training should be used by the seniors of the Changchun Palace to strengthen the bodies of their disciples, and it should not matter how good they were.
Seeing that both companions were very confident, Lin Zhaodi said nothing.
"But in addition to practicing swordsmanship in the morning, I heard that I also have to take literacy classes in the afternoon, and then learn the method of refining qi in the evening... It all sounds very difficult."
She still had a troubled look on her face.
Su Baichen was surprised: "How does sister know so much?"
Wang Xingyuan was equally surprised: "Why don't you know this?"
Su Baichen was speechless. The Taoist priest Chang Gu sent him here yesterday. He talked a lot of nonsense along the way but did not say what he would face next.
Wang Xingyuan sighed: "Okay, I'll tell you briefly."
"The first three months are the learning stage for all new outer sect disciples. Study the "Eternal Spring Sutra", learn basic swordsmanship, learn Qi refining techniques, and read and write."
"After March, if someone can directly introduce the Qi into the body, he can be accepted into the sect and become a formal disciple, and he can learn more from his master."
"If it doesn't work, you have to take on a lot of chores and try to practice on your own while completing some tasks for the Changchun Palace."
"So if you can become a formal disciple after three months, you can continue to concentrate on your cultivation. Otherwise, you will have to waste time in the outer sect."
Su Baichen kept nodding. He thought this rule was very reasonable.
He had been wondering before, how did the Changchun Palace support so many outer disciples? Now it's answered.
After a quarter of an hour's rest after the meal, everyone went to the school grounds to gather. It was time to learn the sword.
The person who taught the sword was an elegant gentleman in Qingshan named Qing Fenghan. He was an inner sect swordsman who specialized in teaching outer sects.
When he came up, he asked everyone to practice sword moves with him three times, and then let everyone practice freely. He was interested in giving some advice, but he seemed quite tired.
This kind of casual teaching also made Su Baichen confused for a while. Finally, I relied on my memory to memorize all the opponent's methods three times, and then I and my friends tried it over and over again, and I could barely manage to do something like that all morning.
During this period, Qing Fenghan only glanced at the three-person team here without paying much attention.
